title: Open / Under the Radar Festival

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use cropping and repetition to communicate a varied program because a festival is more than one image.
strategic_value: Two differently cropped photographs can suggest multiplicity while the red frame maintains recognition.
demonstration: A large upper crop of legs and a lower close-up image sit inside red borders beneath a wide Public Open header.
practical_value: Compare a two-image layout with the single-image season posters.

content_islands.name: Upper section
content_islands.spec: Place the large leg crop below the Public header and beside the festival title.

content_islands.name: Lower section
content_islands.spec: Separate the close-up photograph with a red horizontal rule and keep contact details at the base.

reference_purposes.Expression: A large upper crop of legs and a lower close-up image sit inside red borders beneath a wide Public Open header.
reference_purposes.Application: The Under the Radar Festival uses the season frame for a two-image promotional poster.
